description: Constructs numbers with provably long odd-step runs using CRT, engineering high odd/even ratio for large deviations in trajectory length.
mathematical_formalization: n -> (3n+1)/2^v, v = v_2(3n+1). Many v=1 steps → growth as (3/2)^k. P(k consec odd) ~ (1/2)^k.
implementation_hypothesis: CRT construction forcing k consecutive odd steps. Measure total delay.
experiment_seed: For k=10..30, construct smallest n with k consecutive odd steps.
